$meta.title: OML lattice form — finite-trace σ-liftability
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the OML/lattice attack. Load this first; follow detail pointers into the working note for proofs, scope, and session receipts.
$meta.what_is_it: Does every finitely additive two-valued state on a concrete σ-complete OML have each finite trace reproduced by some σ-additive two-valued state?
$meta.status: OPEN — conjectured latticehood implies Φ; no proof or OML counterexample.
$meta.the_shape: Φ is density of σ-additive states inside finitely additive states, not equality. The attack splits into fine blocks, where σ-states are coherent atomic selections, and coarse blocks, where the missing engine is cross-block compact transport. Older mechanisms now survive only as sufficient conditions, narrow routes, or explicit exclusions.

reductions.name: Finite-trace σ-liftability Φ
reductions.one_line: Φ(L): every finite trace realized by a global finitely additive two-valued state is realized by some global σ-additive two-valued state.

reductions.name: Φ as Stone density
reductions.one_line: Φ(L) iff St_σ(L) is dense in St_fa(L) inside {0,1}^L; equality of the two state spaces is not required.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): phi_iff_dense machine-checked axiom-free -- Phi iff St_sigma dense in St_fa on the Cantor cube over the carrier; plus isClosed_stFA (f.a. states = closed constraint set, kit gap 4.2(a)) and isCompact_stFA (Tychonoff). Also phi_iff_phiCluster (cluster form, latticehood-free both ways) + cluster_extension

reductions.name: Blockwise gluing reduction
reductions.one_line: σ-additivity is blockwise, so global σ-states are exactly coherent choices of σ-states across Boolean blocks.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLBlocks.lean (2026-07-11 s17): A1a exists_isMaxBlock_superset, A1b IsMaxBlock.{empty,univ,compl,iUnion}_mem, A1c isSigmaOn_carrier_iff_maxBlocks -- axiom-free (classical base only), #print axioms receipts in file

reductions.name: Two-block rescue
reductions.one_line: A coherent value-1 pattern supported in at most two blocks is Dirac-rescued; any witness needs at least three blocks.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): two_block_rescue machine-checked axiom-free -- value-1 part covered by two maximal blocks implies Dirac-rescued; only use of latticehood is A2 in-block inter-closure (val_finsetInf), exactly as the note says

reductions.name: Cluster normal form
reductions.one_line: The open frontier reduces to coherent clusters of at least three pairwise-incompatible block-meets with pairwise intersections but empty global kernel.

reductions.name: Fine/coarse factorization
reductions.one_line: The lattice question factors into B′(i) for countably generated blocks and a separate coarse-block coherence question.

fine_block_route.name: B′(i): countably generated blocks imply Φ
fine_block_route.one_line: On carriers whose blocks are countably generated, prove that every finitely coherent finite trace has a coherent pointed global realization.
fine_block_route.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): BPrimeI stated as named open Prop (universe-polymorphic; hypotheses = MeetsExist + CountablyGeneratedBlocks); ladder equivalences phi_iff_phiCluster / phi_iff_dense / phiCluster_iff_pointedSelection machine-checked

fine_block_route.name: Pointed iff σ on fine blocks
fine_block_route.one_line: For countably generated blocks, global σ-states are exactly coherent blockwise atomic selections.
fine_block_route.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): P= FULLY machine-checked, axiom-free -- pointed_iff_sigma (iff), isSigmaOn_of_blockwisePointed (backward leg: NO countable generation, NO latticehood -- banked sharpening formal), blockwisePointed_of_isSigmaOn (forward via T3), phiCluster_iff_pointedSelection (selection reading). fine_block_route.name: Pointed-state density
fine_block_route.one_line: B′(i) is equivalent to density of blockwise-pointed states among finitely additive two-valued states.

fine_block_route.name: One-block repointing crux
fine_block_route.one_line: Given a coherent cluster plus existing block pointings, can one point one further block while preserving finite-additive coherence?

fine_block_route.name: T4 finitary shadow
fine_block_route.one_line: Every coherent cluster must admit a coherent atom from each further block; necessary for B′(i), but insufficient without a completion principle.
fine_block_route.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): T4At/T4 stated as named open Props (never sorry); NECESSITY direction machine-checked axiom-free: t4At_of_phi / bPrimeI_implies_T4 (B'(i) => T4; the T3 kernel is proved to be an atom of the block). Converse NOT stated -- crux red flag respected

coarse_block_route.name: B′(ii): coarse-block coherence
coarse_block_route.one_line: Determine whether interlocking coarse blocks can coherently support finite-additive patterns while excluding every global σ-selection.

coarse_block_route.name: Non-principal block σ-states
coarse_block_route.one_line: Coarse σ-fields can carry non-principal two-valued σ-states, so point-selection does not describe the entire σ-side.
coarse_block_route.lean: MarczewskiTransport.lean (2026-07-11 s18): the omega_1 coarse killer certified axiom-free -- cocountableState is a sigma-additive TwoValuedState, non-Dirac, on a NOT-countably-generated sigma-field (corollary of T3); cocountableClass (with empty set adjoined) is countably compact and Marczewski-approximates it. InnerRegularity.lean: it fails (8.1) at a specific F on uncountable second-countable Hausdorff (condensation point route) and somewhere on every uncountable Hausdorff (via theorem-let R)

coarse_block_route.name: Cross-block compact transport
coarse_block_route.one_line: The required regularity is one countably compact class that Marczewski-approximates every interlocking block in-block, not merely a Polish representation.
coarse_block_route.lean: MarczewskiTransport.lean (2026-07-11 s18): the CORRECTED (s16) criterion machine-checked axiom-free -- CountablyCompactClass (M 1953 sequence form) + ApproximatesOn (value-1 inner witness D in Bl, D<=K<=E) => IsMaxBlock.isSigmaOn_of_compact_class (in-block 4(i)) + compact_transport (OML form via A1c). The approximation-vs-refinement inequivalence is now structural: the Lean hypothesis IS approximation

coarse_block_route.name: DW/Maharam regularization
coarse_block_route.one_line: Inner regularity plus a common intersection-stable compact witness can upgrade finite additivity, but representability alone does not supply that witness.

unitality_route.name: PP1994 unitality/subadditivity engine
unitality_route.one_line: A sufficiently separating unital subadditive family of σ-states could force Booleanity and thereby constrain a counterexample.

unitality_route.name: Universal JP forcing
unitality_route.one_line: Latticehood does not force every σ-state to be Jauch–Piron; MO₂ refutes the first formulation, leaving only narrower hypotheses.

counterexample_construction.name: Coarse-block toy
counterexample_construction.one_line: First build a concrete σ-class OML with a genuinely coarse block, incompatible overlap, and a non-principal blockwise σ-state.

counterexample_construction.name: T4 counterexample hunt
counterexample_construction.one_line: A coherent cluster and further block violating T4 would refute B′(i) outright.

counterexample_construction.name: Full concrete OML witness
counterexample_construction.one_line: Construct L in the admissible concrete σ-complete OML class with a finite trace in im St_fa but outside im St_σ.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Singleton quarantine
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Fine singleton rigidity of the product-Ulam type destroys latticehood; this excludes that mechanism, not every possible OML witness.
mechanism_exclusions.lean: ConcreteOMLBlocks.lean (2026-07-11 s18): T1 machine-checked axiom-free in the s12 sharpened form -- compat_of_locally_resolved (pointwise carrier cover of the overlap forces compat, no exhaustion), compat_of_singletons, interClosed_of_singletons (all-singletons lattice is Boolean); PoorPair anatomy (P1) incl. propagation + singleton-freeness

mechanism_exclusions.name: Boolean-or-horizontal overlap dichotomy
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: The finite Greechie pentagon refutes the proposed structural dichotomy while satisfying Φ automatically.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Disjoint-union-only overlaps
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Blocks and their overlaps in the concrete σ-class OML setting are σ-fields, so the OMP witness's overlap geometry cannot persist.
mechanism_exclusions.lean: ConcreteOMLBlocks.lean (2026-07-11 s17-s18): A2 FULLY machine-checked, AXIOM-FREE -- IsMaxBlock.inter_mem + toMeasurableSpace (blocks are sigma-fields) + overlapMeasurableSpace (overlaps are sigma-fields). The anticipated Foulis-Holland axiom proved unnecessary: meet squeeze compat_of_locally_resolved + set distributivity gives commutant closure (compat_inter_left); Bruns-Harding now cited for the abstract theorem only

mechanism_exclusions.name: Polish representation alone
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Polish representability without in-block regularity and a shared compact witness does not prove Φ.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Empty kernel as intrinsic obstruction
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: K(s)=∅ depends on the chosen concrete representation and cannot classify the abstract OML state by itself.

external_sufficient_conditions.name: Finite carriers
external_sufficient_conditions.one_line: Finite carriers satisfy Φ because finite and countable additivity coincide.

external_sufficient_conditions.name: Horizontal sums
external_sufficient_conditions.one_line: Horizontal-sum-like carriers lie in the known tame region, though they do not exhaust concrete irreducible OMLs.
